question: 今年各家执收单位经手的收入金额排下来，前十名是哪些单位？
sql: SELECT dim_agen.fagenname AS fagenname, sum(paybook_full_high.famt) AS "非税缴款金额" FROM yunnan0508.fne_paybook_full_high AS paybook_full_high LEFT JOIN (SELECT fagenidcode, fagencode, fagenname, flevel, ftypecode, fpidcode, toString(fisleaf) AS fisleaf FROM (SELECT fagenidcode, fagencode, fagenname, flevel, ftypecode, fpidcode, toString(fisleaf) AS fisleaf, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY fagenidcode ORDER BY fupdatetime DESC) AS _rn FROM yunnan0508.fab_agen) WHERE _rn = 1) AS dim_agen ON paybook_full_high.fchgagenidcode = dim_agen.fagenidcode WHERE toDate(paybook_full_high.ffilldate) >= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND toDate(paybook_full_high.ffilldate) < CAST('2027-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY dim_agen.fagenname ORDER BY "非税缴款金额" DESC LIMIT 10 SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1
